pg.name: Sunrise PG
pg.rule: Rent is due on or before the 5th of every month.
Gate closes at 10:30 PM. Inform the warden for late entry.
Visitors are allowed in the common area from 9 AM to 8 PM only.
One month notice is required before vacating. Deposit is refunded after room check.
Keep rooms and shared kitchens clean. No smoking or alcohol inside.
